name: Retire Pipeline
description: Safely decommissions workloads that are no longer required. Includes data archival and stakeholder sign-off.

tasks.name: Confirm Retirement Approval
tasks.description: Application owner and business stakeholder formally approve the workload for retirement.

tasks.name: Identify Data Retention Requirements
tasks.description: Review data retention policies and identify data sets requiring archival.

tasks.name: Archive Data
tasks.description: Copy identified data sets to long-term cold storage (e.g. S3 Glacier, Azure Archive).

tasks.name: Revoke Access & Update CMDB
tasks.description: Remove IAM roles, AD accounts, and firewall rules associated with the workload. Update the CMDB.

tasks.name: Shutdown Workload
tasks.description: Stop all running processes and power off the source server/instance.

tasks.name: Terminate Resources
tasks.description: Final sign-off before permanent resource deletion. Resources will be terminated after approval.
